155.sql: SELECT MIN(t.Date||' '||t.Time) first_ts, MAX(t.Date||' '||t.Time) last_ts, (julianday(MAX(t.Date||' '||t.Time))-julianday(MIN(t.Date||' '||t.Time)))*1440 float_minutes, (strftime('%s',MAX(t.Date||' '||t.Time))-strftime('%s',MIN(t.Date||' '||t.Time)))/60 exact_minutes FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON g.GasStationID=t.GasStationID WHERE g.Country='CZE' AND t.Price>1000
